WITH apparel_tenants AS (
  SELECT id AS tenant_id
  FROM tenants
  WHERE industry = 'Apparel & Footwear'
),
eligible_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.tenant_id, u.created_at
  FROM users u
  JOIN apparel_tenants t ON t.tenant_id = u.tenant_id
  WHERE u.is_staff = false
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM orders o
      WHERE o.user_id = u.id
        AND o.tenant_id = u.tenant_id
        AND o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2023-01-01'
        AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
    )
),
loyalty_group AS (
  SELECT
    eu.user_id,
    CASE
      WHEN la.user_id IS NULL THEN 'non-member'
      WHEN lb.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'ever-redeemed member'
      ELSE 'never-redeemed member'
    END AS customer_group
  FROM eligible_users eu
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM loyalty_accounts) la
    ON la.user_id = eu.user_id
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM loyalty_transactions WHERE direction = 'burn') lb
    ON lb.user_id = eu.user_id
),
tenure AS (
  SELECT
    eu.user_id,
    CASE
      WHEN (DATE '2025-12-31' - eu.created_at::date) < 182 THEN 'under 6 months'
      WHEN (DATE '2025-12-31' - eu.created_at::date) < 365 THEN '6 to 12 months'
      WHEN (DATE '2025-12-31' - eu.created_at::date) < 730 THEN '12 to 24 months'
      ELSE 'over 24 months'
    END AS tenure_band
  FROM eligible_users eu
),
orders_scoped AS (
  SELECT
    o.id AS order_id,
    o.user_id,
    o.status,
    CASE WHEN o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN
      CASE WHEN o.currency_code = 'EUR' THEN o.grand_total
           ELSE o.grand_total / er.rate END
    ELSE NULL END AS revenue_eur,
    CASE WHEN o.status <> 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_noncancelled,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments p WHERE p.order_id = o.id AND p.amount_refunded > 0)
         OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_returns r WHERE r.order_id = o.id)
    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_refunded
  FROM orders o
  JOIN eligible_users eu ON eu.user_id = o.user_id AND eu.tenant_id = o.tenant_id
  LEFT JOIN exchange_rates er
    ON er.base_code = 'EUR'
    AND er.quote_code = o.currency_code
    AND er.as_of = o.placed_at::date
),
user_agg AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    COUNT(*) AS lifetime_orders,
    SUM(is_noncancelled) AS noncancelled_orders,
    SUM(COALESCE(revenue_eur, 0)) AS lifetime_revenue_eur,
    SUM(is_refunded) AS refunded_orders
  FROM orders_scoped
  GROUP BY user_id
),
user_level AS (
  SELECT
    t.tenure_band,
    lg.customer_group,
    ua.lifetime_orders,
    ua.noncancelled_orders,
    ua.lifetime_revenue_eur,
    ua.refunded_orders
  FROM eligible_users eu
  JOIN tenure t ON t.user_id = eu.user_id
  JOIN loyalty_group lg ON lg.user_id = eu.user_id
  JOIN user_agg ua ON ua.user_id = eu.user_id
)
SELECT
  tenure_band,
  customer_group AS "group",
  COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
  ROUND(AVG(lifetime_orders)::numeric, 2) AS avg_lifetime_orders,
  ROUND(AVG(lifetime_revenue_eur)::numeric, 2) AS avg_lifetime_revenue_eur,
  ROUND((SUM(lifetime_revenue_eur) / NULLIF(SUM(noncancelled_orders), 0))::numeric, 2) AS avg_order_value_eur,
  ROUND((100.0 * SUM(refunded_orders) / NULLIF(SUM(lifetime_orders), 0))::numeric, 2) AS refund_rate_pct
FROM user_level
GROUP BY tenure_band, customer_group
ORDER BY
  CASE tenure_band
    WHEN 'under 6 months' THEN 1
    WHEN '6 to 12 months' THEN 2
    WHEN '12 to 24 months' THEN 3
    WHEN 'over 24 months' THEN 4
  END,
  CASE customer_group
    WHEN 'non-member' THEN 1
    WHEN 'never-redeemed member' THEN 2
    WHEN 'ever-redeemed member' THEN 3
  END

text:
Submitted. Summary of key choices made explicit in the note to Ingrid:

- **Tenure bands**: computed from day-count differences (182/365/730 days) between `users.created_at` and 2025-12-31, as a standard proxy for 6/12/24-month boundaries.
- **Population**: non-staff users in Apparel & Footwear tenants with at least one order (any status) placed between 2023-01-01 and 2025-12-31.
- **Grouping**: non-member (no `loyalty_accounts` row) vs never-redeemed (has account, no `burn` transaction) vs ever-redeemed (has account, at least one `burn` transaction).
- **Revenue/AOV**: non-cancelled orders only, converted to EUR via `exchange_rates` keyed on `placed_at` date; AOV is the group's total revenue divided by total non-cancelled order count (not an average of per-customer ratios).
- **Lifetime orders & refund rate**: computed over all orders regardless of status; refund = any `payments.amount_refunded > 0` or an `order_returns` row for that order.
